title: Raccoon dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="92" rx="30" ry="5" fill="#3a2a5a"/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M72 75 Q88 60 82 45 Q78 36 70 40 Q74 50 66 60 Q62 68 68 76 Z" fill="#8a8aa8"/>
  <path d="M78 52 Q84 46 82 42" stroke="#d8d8f0" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M73 63 Q80 58 80 52" stroke="#d8d8f0" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M68 73 Q74 68 73 63" stroke="#d8d8f0" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- left leg (dancing up) -->
  <path d="M38 78 Q32 84 28 88 Q26 93 32 93 Q36 93 38 88 Z" fill="#6a6a88"/>
  <ellipse cx="31" cy="91" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#4a4a68"/>

  <!-- right leg (dancing out) -->
  <path d="M56 78 Q62 82 68 86 Q72 91 66 93 Q62 93 60 88 Z" fill="#6a6a88"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="91" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#4a4a68"/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="20" ry="18" fill="#8a8aa8"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="70" rx="14" ry="12" fill="#b0b0d0"/>

  <!-- left arm waving up -->
  <path d="M32 56 Q20 50 16 36 Q15 30 20 32 Q26 44 36 52 Z" fill="#7a7a98"/>
  <circle cx="18" cy="31" r="4" fill="#4a4a68"/>

  <!-- right arm out -->
  <path d="M68 58 Q80 56 86 48 Q90 43 85 43 Q78 49 70 54 Z" fill="#7a7a98"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="45" r="4" fill="#4a4a68"/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="22" ry="19" fill="#8a8aa8"/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <path d="M30 28 Q24 14 34 20 Q38 22 38 28 Z" fill="#6a6a88"/>
  <path d="M34 24 Q30 18 34 21 Z" fill="#c0c0e0"/>
  <path d="M70 28 Q76 14 66 20 Q62 22 62 28 Z" fill="#6a6a88"/>
  <path d="M66 24 Q70 18 66 21 Z" fill="#c0c0e0"/>

  <!-- mask -->
  <path d="M28 36 Q30 30 38 32 Q42 33 44 36 Q38 40 28 36 Z" fill="#4a4a68"/>
  <path d="M72 36 Q70 30 62 32 Q58 33 56 36 Q62 40 72 36 Z" fill="#4a4a68"/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="35" r="4" fill="#f0f0ff"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="35" r="2" fill="#2a2a48"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="35" r="4" fill="#f0f0ff"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="35" r="2" fill="#2a2a48"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="34" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="34" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="44" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#d0d0e8"/>

  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="42" rx="3.5" ry="2.5" fill="#30304a"/>

  <!-- mouth (happy) -->
  <path d="M46 46 Q50 50 54 46" stroke="#5a5a78" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="42" r="3" fill="#e0a0b8" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="42" r="3" fill="#e0a0b8" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- musical notes floating -->
  <path d="M80 20 L80 28 M80 20 L86 18 L86 26" stroke="#ffd860" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="29" r="2.5" fill="#ffd860"/>
  <circle cx="84" cy="27" r="2.5" fill="#ffd860"/>

  <path d="M14 20 L14 26" stroke="#ffd860" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="12" cy="27" r="2.5" fill="#ffd860"/>
</svg>
